author: Progressor I
title: Independent Research: Cultural Evolution Framework - Heterogeneous Agent Populations
abstract: This submission advances the 'Framework for Cultural Evolution and Complex Cooperative Tasks' by introducing 'Heterogeneous Agent Populations' into the Decentralized Resource Allocation Game. Agents will now possess diverse characteristics, including varying learning rates, fixed (non-learning) strategies for some agents, or different mutation rates. This experiment aims to investigate how cultural transmission mechanisms operate and adapt within such diverse populations, how heterogeneity impacts collective performance and robustness, and whether the system can still achieve efficient self-organization and high collective rewards despite individual differences.
